scope: Apply only PostgreSQL schema migration 435 to the local Kokonut Kernel candidate after a fresh encrypted checkpoint and isolated restore rehearsal.

checkpoint.scope_limit: Single PostgreSQL database only. Roles/grants, other databases, Compose volumes, provider state, and external media are excluded.

restore_rehearsal.restore_method: age decryption streamed directly into pg_restore with --exit-on-error --single-transaction --no-owner --no-privileges

candidate_rollout.command: python3 -m services.migration.cli migrate --schemas-only --only-migration schema:435_financial_projection_conflict_guard.sql --compose-project kokonut-kernel-candidate --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-candidate.yml --compose-file docker-compose.kernel-local-db.yml

rollback.migration_failure_behavior: The migration runner executes each migration transactionally, so an apply error leaves migration 435 unapplied.
rollback.database_recovery: Retain the encrypted pre-435 checkpoint. For database recovery, restore it to a fresh isolated PostgreSQL target, verify it, then use a separately reviewed candidate replacement; do not overwrite the live candidate with pg_restore.
rollback.application_recovery: The candidate app image and container were not changed during this database-only rollout.

limitations: The restore verifies the migration ledger, extension versions, and public relation count; it does not establish populated farm-data, external media, cluster-role/grant, provider, or full-system backup parity.
The migration protects create-time sales and expense projections. Financial update/delete reconciliation, historical backfill, ClickHouse delivery, and populated report/dashboard parity remain open.
The local rollout does not establish production recovery, tenant-wide RLS, physical Raspberry Pi behavior, or named MAN-CAP acceptance.
